reason: Reports TPA texture of fermented mycelium-based meat analogs after two named thermal treatments (steaming vs baking) at six curdlan levels; no raw/unheated values are in this table, so only a steam-vs-bake contrast is expressed.
foods: fermented mycelium-based meat analogs (Pleurotus eryngii mycelium with SPI-cassava starch gel, 0-5% w/w curdlan, 3D printed)
treatments: steaming in a steamer at 100 °C for 20 min; baking in a steam oven with upper and lower heating elements at 180 °C for 10 min
methods_quote: For steaming, the samples were heated in a steamer at 100 °C for 20 min. For baking, the samples were heated in a steam oven with the upper and lower heating elements set at 180 °C for 10 min.
units: Hardness (g); Adhesiveness (g.s); Springiness, Cohesiveness, Chewiness (no unit stated)
replicates: Data are presented as mean ± standard deviation, n = 3
